conceptual replication and extension of their Experiment 1 with 3,323 U.S. Americans using

targets.authors: Gino, F., Ayal, S., & Ariely, D.
targets.title: Contagion and Differentiation in Unethical Behavior: The Effect of One Bad Apple on the Barrel.
targets.evidence_quote:
We conducted a preregistered conceptual replication of Gino, Ayal, et al. (2009) using

a large-scale, incentive-aligned online experiment with 3,323 U.S. American participants.
targets.outcome_quote:
Together, these results reveal a boundary condition

such that the original intergroup contagion-and-differentiation effect on individual dishonest

behavior does not generalize when statistical norms are delivered online in the context of a

binary honesty task.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Overall verdict rejects generalization of the focal ingroup versus outgroup effect; exploratory norm effects do not establish the tested intergroup claim.

reasoning: Accepted manuscript title, authors and printed published DOI match. Completed single new-sample experiment specifically retests Experiment 1. Other studies are background, paradigm sources or contextual comparisons, not separate designed targets.
